title: FLA writer fidelity leftovers outside task 1386: multi-run text collapsed to one run, text-run schema byte 0x01 vs real 0x0C, PAGE_TAIL nextLayerId/currentFrame hardcoded, layer isSelected heuristic
description: Grab-bag of verified write-path fidelity gaps in write/timeline-write.ts that are NOT in task 1386's scope (filters/color-effects/gradient+bitmap fills/custom ease/mask+parent/guides): (1) MULTI-RUN TEXT DATA LOSS — writeCPicText (:855-905) always emits a SINGLE text run built from the top-level fontFamily/fontSize/color/bold/italic fields; a TextDisplayObject imported from a real FLA with multiple formatting runs (model html/htmlText, import path flash8-import.ts:1095-1140, task 0871) is flattened to first-run styling on save. The importer reads a run LOOP (readCPicText :2685-2708), so the writer can emit one run per model run once the model regains per-run data (htmlText needs parsing back to runs, or persist the Fla8TextRun array). Also characterPosition (charPos byte) is written as 0 always (:920) though the model carries it. (2) RUN SCHEMA BYTE — writeTextRunFields (:909) stamps the run version byte as 0x01; docs/21 sec 17.3 and the sec 3 constant table say real Flash 8 writes textVersionB = 0x0C. Our reader skips the byte (readTextRunFields r.skip(1)) so round-trip hides it, but a real Flash 8 reader may gate run fields on it — byte-fidelity risk (needs oracle to confirm; keep flagged). (3) PAGE_TAIL CONSTANTS — writeCPicPage (:126-140) emits the fixed PAGE_TAIL template for EVERY timeline, hardcoding nextLayerId=3 and currentFrame from the empty fixture regardless of actual layer count/playhead; real Flash derives them. Harmless to our importer (it skips them) but wrong for real Flash and for multi-layer docs. (4) LAYER isSelected — writeCPicLayer (:176) synthesizes isSelected from 'locked || !visible' which is semantically unrelated; emit 0 or model selection state. Why it matters: these are the remaining known divergences between the writer and both the spec and the importer beyond 1386; (1) is genuine authored-data loss today. Fix each; acceptance: (1) round-trip test asserting a 2-run text field survives saveRealFla->tryLoadRealFla with per-run font/color/bold intact and characterPosition round-trips; (3) test asserting nextLayerId=layerCount+1 and currentFrame from the model are stamped (importer-side read optional); (2)+(4) byte-golden assertions on the emitted run version byte/flag once the real-Flash oracle question (task 1406 fixtures) is settled — until then implement per docs/21 sec 17.3 and keep the strict-carchive gate green.
